ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels to 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located high-intensity white regions spanning the interior of both lobes; low-intensity black margins at the trailing and lateral edges with numerous vertical black striations extending inward from the margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; vertical notch depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged profile with high-frequency serrations; pixel amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels from the mean boundary line, concentrated on the lateral portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve originating at the median notch and sweeping steeply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast tan/white pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple dark, sub-parallel vertical linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jaggedness and indentations along the trailing edge indicating historical tissue loss; prominent barnacle encrustations at lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-density cluster of bio-fouling on the right lobe tip protruding noticeably from the geometric fluke outline.
